title: Haber dili
canDo: Haber ve resmî metinlerde kişisiz edilgen yapıları (It is said that ..., He is believed to have ...) anlayıp kullanabilir, There is thought to be ve edilgen mastar / -ing yapılarını uygulayabilir, gazete başlıklarının özel dilbilgisini çözebilir ve kaynakları doğru belirten nesnel bir haber metni yazabilirim.

Özne + is said / thought + to V1 / to have V3
There is thought to be ...; edilgen mastar ve -ing
gazete başlıkları dilbilgisi ve haber kelimeleri
nesnel haber yazımı ve kaynak belirtme

liveClass.title: Haber merkezi
liveClass.goal: Gruplar bir haber ajansında çalışıyor. Her gruba doğrulanmamış bilgiler içeren bir olay kartı verilir (bir hırsızlık, bir keşif, bir ünlünün açıklaması). Gruplar bilgileri kişisiz edilgen yapılarla (is believed to have, It is reported that) haber bültenine dönüştürür ve bir başlık yazar. Sınıf en nesnel ve en etkileyici bülteni seçer.

lessons.title: Söylendiğine göre
lessons.goal: It is said / believed / reported that ... yapısıyla bilgiyi kişisiz ve mesafeli bir şekilde aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Haber: Müzeden çalınan tablo
discover.body:
A valuable painting has been stolen from the City Art Museum.

It is believed that the thieves entered the building through a skylight on Sunday night. It is reported that the alarm system had been switched off for maintenance.

The painting, a 19th-century landscape, is thought to be worth around two million euros. It has been suggested that the theft was carried out by a professional gang.

It is understood that police are examining security camera footage from nearby streets. It is not yet known whether anyone working at the museum was involved.

A museum spokesperson declined to comment.

questions.prompt: How did the thieves probably enter?

options: It was broken by the thieves.
It had been switched off for maintenance.
questions.explanation: "the alarm system had been switched off for maintenance"

learn.explanation:
Haberlerde ve resmî metinlerde bilginin **kaynağı belirsizse** ya da gazeteci **mesafeli** durmak istiyorsa kişisiz edilgen yapı kullanılır.

**It + is / was + V3 (reporting verb) + that + cümle**

| Etken (kim söylediği belli) | Kişisiz edilgen |
|---|---|
| People **say** that he is rich. | **It is said that** he is rich. |
| Police **believe** that the thieves ... | **It is believed that** the thieves ... |
| Experts **expect** that prices will rise. | **It is expected that** prices will rise. |
| Someone **reported** that ... | **It was reported that** ... |

**Sık kullanılan fiiller:**

*say, believe, think, report, claim, allege, expect, understand, know, suggest, estimate, rumour, fear, hope, consider, agree*

**Zaman uyumu:**

- ***It is** said **that** he **lives** abroad.* (şimdi söyleniyor, şimdi yaşıyor)
- ***It was** reported **that** the fire **had started** in the kitchen.* (geçmişte bildirildi)

**Neden kullanılır?**

1. Kaynak bilinmiyor ya da önemli değil.
2. Bilgi **doğrulanmamış**; gazeteci sorumluluk almak istemiyor.
3. Resmî ve nesnel bir üslup.

**It is not yet known whether ...** = ... olup olmadığı henüz bilinmiyor.

examples.en: It is said that the castle is haunted.
It is expected that the minister will resign.
It was reported that two people had been injured.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "... olduğu söyleniyor", "... sanılıyor", "... bildirildi" yapıları çok yaygındır ve İngilizcedeki "It is said / thought / reported that" ile birebir örtüşür. Türkçe haber dilinde ayrıca "-mış" eki ("Hırsızlar çatıdan girmiş") de bu işi görür; İngilizcede bu eke karşılık gelen tek bir yapı yoktur, bu nedenle "It is believed that the thieves entered..." gibi açık yapılar kullanılır.

options: It is believed that the thieves entered through the roof.
It believes that the thieves entered through the roof.
Kaynak belirsiz ya da bilgi doğrulanmamış olduğunda
It is say that he's rich.
It is said that he's rich.

It is said that the restaurant is the best in town
It's said that the restaurant is the best in town.
It's said that the restaurant is the best in town

task.prompt: Bir radyo spikeri olarak şehrinizde olan hayalî bir olayı (bir hırsızlık, bir keşif, bir trafik kazası) kısa bir haber bülteniyle duyurun. En az 5 farklı It + passive + that yapısı kullanın: It is believed / reported / thought / expected / understood / claimed that ... ve It is not yet known whether ...
task.modelAnswer: Good morning. Here is the news. A rare Roman mosaic has been discovered during building work in the city centre. It is believed that the mosaic dates back to the second century. It is reported that construction workers found it while digging the foundations of a new hotel. It is thought that the site may contain other ancient objects. It is expected that archaeologists will begin excavations next week. However, it is not yet known whether the hotel project will be cancelled. It is understood that the city council will meet on Friday to discuss the issue.

lessons.title: Olduğuna inanılıyor
lessons.goal: Özne + is said / thought / believed + to V1 / to be -ing / to have V3 yapılarıyla bilgiyi daha kısa ve doğal aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Haber: Kayıp dağcı
discover.body:
A British climber who went missing on Mount Ararat three days ago is believed to be alive.

The 34-year-old, who is said to be an experienced mountaineer, is thought to have left his tent early on Monday morning. He is reported to have been climbing alone when the weather suddenly changed.

Rescue teams are understood to be searching an area just below the summit. A shepherd is said to have seen a man in a red jacket near the glacier on Tuesday.

The climber's family, who are reported to be travelling to Turkey, are expected to arrive in Doğubayazıt tonight.

The search is likely to continue throughout the night.

questions.prompt: What is the climber said to be?
questions.explanation: "is said to be an experienced mountaineer"

options: A man in a red jacket near the glacier
questions.explanation: "a man in a red jacket near the glacier"

learn.explanation:
**Özne + be + V3 (reporting verb) + to-mastar**

Bu yapı "It is said that ..." yapısından **daha kısa ve daha yaygındır**.

| It ... that | Özne + to-mastar |
|---|---|
| It is said that he **is** rich. | He **is said to be** rich. |
| It is thought that she **lives** abroad. | She **is thought to live** abroad. |

**Mastarın zamanı çok önemli:**

| Olay ne zaman? | Mastar | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Şimdi / genel | **to + V1** | He **is said to be** an expert. |
| Şu an devam ediyor | **to be + -ing** | Rescue teams **are understood to be searching** ... |
| Daha önce (geçmiş) | **to have + V3** | He **is thought to have left** on Monday. |
| Geçmişte devam ediyordu | **to have been + -ing** | He **is reported to have been climbing** alone. |
| Edilgen, geçmiş | **to have been + V3** | Two people **are believed to have been injured**. |
| Gelecek | **is expected to** + V1 | They **are expected to arrive** tonight. |

**Dikkat:** **say** ve **think** genellikle **etken** yapıda bu şekilde kullanılmaz:

- ~~People say him to be rich.~~ ✗
- ✓ *He **is said to be** rich.*

**Geçmişte söylenmişse:** *He **was said to be** the richest man in the city.* (o dönemde söyleniyordu)

Bu yapı Türkçe konuşanlar için başlangıçta garip gelebilir. Asıl zorluk mastarın zamanını seçmektir: Olay inanmadan önce olduysa "to have + V3" kullanılır. task.prompt: Ünlü bir kişi hakkında (gerçek ya da hayalî) bir dedikodu programı sunucusu gibi "söylentileri" aktarın. Özne + is said / thought / believed / reported / rumoured + to-mastar yapısını en az 6 kez kullanın; şimdi (to be), devam eden (to be -ing), geçmiş (to have V3) ve gelecek (is expected to) zamanlarından en az birer örnek verin.
task.modelAnswer: Welcome back to Celebrity News! Today's top story: the famous actor Kaan Demir is rumoured to be leaving his hit TV series. He is said to be unhappy with the new scripts. According to sources, he is thought to have argued with the director last month. He is also reported to be working on a new film in Hollywood. His co-star is believed to have known about his decision for weeks. The actor is expected to make an announcement at the end of the season. We'll keep you updated!

lessons.title: Olduğu düşünülen
lessons.goal: There is thought to be ... yapısını, edilgen mastar (to be done) ve edilgen -ing (being done) biçimlerini doğru kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Haber: Yeni keşfedilen mağara
discover.body:
Scientists have discovered an enormous cave system beneath the mountains of eastern Anatolia.

There are thought to be at least 15 kilometres of tunnels, and there is believed to be an underground lake more than 200 metres deep. There are said to be rare species of fish living in complete darkness.

The cave is likely to be explored in more detail next summer. The team leader said she was delighted to have been given the chance to lead the expedition. "Being chosen for this project is the greatest honour of my career," she said.

Local authorities are keen for the area to be protected. "We don't want the cave to be damaged by tourists before it has been properly studied," a spokesperson said.

questions.prompt: What is believed to be in the cave?
options: An underground lake more than 200 metres deep
questions.explanation: "there is believed to be an underground lake"

questions.prompt: What are the local authorities worried about?
questions.explanation: "We don't want the cave to be damaged by tourists"

learn.explanation:
**1. There + be + V3 + to be**

"Var olduğu düşünülüyor / söyleniyor" demek için:

| It ... that | There + passive |
|---|---|
| It is thought that there **are** 15 km of tunnels. | **There are thought to be** 15 km of tunnels. |
| It is believed that there **is** a lake. | **There is believed to be** a lake. |
| It is said that there **were** survivors. | **There are said to have been** survivors. |

**2. Edilgen mastar: to be + V3 / to have been + V3**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **want / expect / hope + to be + V3** | I **want to be told** the truth. |
| **need to be + V3** | The cave **needs to be protected**. |
| **is likely to be + V3** | It **is likely to be explored** next summer. |
| **sb + to be + V3** | We don't want **the cave to be damaged**. |
| **to have been + V3** (geçmiş) | She was delighted **to have been given** the chance. |

**3. Edilgen -ing: being + V3 / having been + V3**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **Being + V3** (özne) | **Being chosen** is a great honour. |
| **hate / love / avoid / remember + being + V3** | I hate **being interrupted**. |
| **without being + V3** | He left **without being seen**. |
| **having been + V3** (geçmiş) | **Having been warned**, they stayed inside. |

examples.en: There are thought to be more than 1,000 species in the forest.
Nobody likes being told what to do.
The results are expected to be published next month.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "15 kilometre tünel olduğu düşünülüyor" cümlesi İngilizcede "There are thought to be 15 km of tunnels" olur; "there" yapısının edilgen hale gelmesi Türkçe konuşanlar için alışılmadık olabilir. Edilgen -ing yapıları da Türkçede "-ılmak" (söz kesilmek, seçilmek) ile karşılanır: "Sözümün kesilmesinden nefret ederim" = "I hate being interrupted". "I hate interrupting" ise "Söz kesmekten nefret ederim" demektir; anlamı tamamen farklıdır.

options: There are thought to be survivors.
I want to tell the truth. (Bana doğru söylensin.)
I want to be told the truth.

accepted: There are thought to be hundreds of birds on the island.

task.prompt: (1) Yeni keşfedilmiş hayalî bir yer (bir ada, bir orman, bir şehir kalıntısı) hakkında There is / are thought / believed / said to be ... yapısıyla en az 3 cümle kurun. (2) Kendinizle ilgili sevdiğiniz ve sevmediğiniz 3'er şeyi edilgen -ing ile söyleyin (I love being ..., I hate being ...). (3) Edilgen mastarla 2 dilek söyleyin (I want to be ..., I'd like to be ...).
task.modelAnswer: One: Scientists have found a small island in the Pacific. There are thought to be several species of birds that live nowhere else. There is believed to be fresh water in the centre of the island, and there are said to be the remains of an old village. Two: I love being surprised, I love being invited to dinner, and I love being given flowers. I hate being interrupted, I hate being kept waiting, and I really hate being woken up early. Three: I'd like to be promoted next year, and I want to be told the truth, even when it's difficult.

lessons.title: Başlıkları çözmek
lessons.goal: Gazete başlıklarının özel dilbilgisini (atlanan kelimeler, zaman kuralları) ve tipik başlık kelimelerini anlayabilirim.

discover.title: Bugünün manşetleri
discover.body:
1. MAYOR VOWS TO FIX CITY ROADS BY SUMMER

2. THREE HURT IN MOTORWAY CRASH

3. PM TO VISIT JAPAN NEXT MONTH

4. CRITICS SLAM NEW TAX PLAN

5. STAR STRIKER IN BID TO JOIN SPANISH CLUB

6. ROW OVER AIRPORT EXPANSION GROWS

7. BANK BOSS QUITS AMID FRAUD PROBE

8. TEENAGER SAVES DROWNING CHILD

9. MISSING CLIMBER FOUND ALIVE

options: The PM is in Japan now.

learn.explanation:
**Gazete başlıkları (headlines)** yer kazanmak için özel bir dilbilgisi kullanır.

**1. Kelimeler atlanır:**

- **Article** (a, the): *~~The~~ Mayor vows to fix ~~the~~ roads*
- **be fiili**: *Missing climber ~~is~~ found alive*

**2. Zaman kuralları:**

| Başlık | Gerçek anlam | Kural |
|---|---|---|
| Teenager **saves** child | A teenager **has saved / saved** a child. | **Present simple → yakın geçmiş** |
| PM **to visit** Japan | The PM **is going to / will** visit Japan. | **to + V1 → gelecek** |
| Three **hurt** in crash | Three people **were / have been hurt**. | **V3 → edilgen** (be atlanmış) |
| Row over airport **grows** | The row **is growing**. | Present simple → şimdi |

**3. Kısa ve dramatik kelimeler ("headlinese"):**

| Başlık kelimesi | Normal anlam |
|---|---|
| **vow** | promise |
| **slam** | criticise strongly |
| **bid** | attempt |
| **row** | argument / disagreement |
| **probe** | investigation |
| **quit** | resign |
| **axe** | cut / cancel (jobs, plans) |
| **back** | support |
| **clash** | fight / disagree |
| **hit** | affect badly |
| **boost** | increase, help |
| **amid** | during, while (a problem) |

**4. İsim dizileri:** *Bank boss fraud probe* = an investigation into fraud involving the boss of a bank

examples.en: Government to axe 500 jobs = The government is going to cut 500 jobs.
Storm hits coast = A storm has hit the coast.
Minister backs new plan = The minister supports the new plan.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe gazete başlıkları da kısa ve dramatiktir ("Bakan istifa etti", "Şehir sele teslim"). İngilizce başlıkların en kafa karıştırıcı yanı zaman kurallarıdır: "Teenager saves child" şimdiki zaman gibi görünse de aslında geçmişte olmuş bir olayı anlatır. "PM to visit Japan" ise gelecek planıdır. Bir başka tuzak "row" kelimesidir: Başlıklarda "kürek çekmek" değil, "tartışma, kavga" anlamına gelir ve /raʊ/ diye okunur.

practice.prompt: "Teenager saves drowning child" olay ne zaman?

practice.text: Başlık: "Bank boss ___ amid scandal" (istifa etti)
Başlık: "Police launch ___ into missing funds" (soruşturma)
Başlık: "Mayor ___ to build new hospital" (söz verdi)
Başlık: "Company to ___ 200 jobs" (kesmek, iptal etmek)

practice.audioText: And now, the headlines. Flooding hits eastern villages. Government to announce new housing plan on Friday. And in sport, national team coach quits after shock defeat.
practice.prompt: Milli takım teknik direktörü hakkında ne söyleniyor?

task.prompt: (1) Aşağıdaki başlıkları tam cümlelerle açıklayın: "Storm hits coast", "PM to visit Brazil", "Five hurt in fire", "Club in bid to sign star", "Teachers slam exam changes". (2) Ardından şehrinizde ya da okulunuzda geçen hafta olan 3 olay için kendi gazete başlıklarınızı oluşturun ve okuyun.
task.modelAnswer: One: 'Storm hits coast' means a storm has hit the coast. 'PM to visit Brazil' means the Prime Minister is going to visit Brazil. 'Five hurt in fire' means five people were hurt in a fire. 'Club in bid to sign star' means a club is trying to sign a star player. 'Teachers slam exam changes' means teachers have strongly criticised the changes to the exams. Two: My headlines: 'Local café wins national award', 'School to open new science lab', and 'Residents slam plans for car park'.

lessons.title: Haber yazmak
lessons.goal: Ters piramit yapısı, kaynak belirtme ve kişisiz edilgen yapılarla nesnel bir haber metni yazabilirim.

discover.title: Örnek haber
discover.body:
HUNDREDS EVACUATED AS WILDFIRE SPREADS

More than 800 residents were evacuated from villages near Muğla yesterday as a wildfire spread rapidly through nearby forests.

The fire, which is believed to have started in a field on Tuesday afternoon, has already destroyed an estimated 500 hectares of pine forest. Strong winds are thought to have helped it spread.

According to the regional governor's office, 12 helicopters and more than 300 firefighters are currently working to control the flames. No casualties have been reported, although two firefighters are said to have been treated for smoke inhalation.

The cause of the fire has not yet been confirmed. However, officials have not ruled out the possibility that it was started deliberately. An investigation has been launched.

"We have never seen a fire spread so fast," said Hasan Yıldız, a farmer from one of the evacuated villages. "We left with nothing."

The fire is expected to be brought under control by the weekend, provided the wind drops.

questions.prompt: What is said about the cause?
options: It has not yet been confirmed.
questions.explanation: "The cause of the fire has not yet been confirmed."

learn.explanation:
**Ters piramit (inverted pyramid) yapısı:**

| Bölüm | İçerik | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Başlık** | Kısa, dramatik (başlık dilbilgisi) | *Hundreds evacuated as wildfire spreads* |
| **Giriş (lead)** | En önemli bilgi: **Ne? Kim? Nerede? Ne zaman?** | *More than 800 residents were evacuated ... yesterday ...* |
| **Ayrıntılar** | **Nasıl? Neden?** + rakamlar | *The fire, which is believed to have started ...* |
| **Kaynaklar** | Resmî açıklamalar | *According to the governor's office, ...* |
| **Alıntı** | Tanık ya da uzman sözü | *"We left with nothing," said ...* |
| **Sonraki adım** | Ne olacak? | *The fire is expected to be brought under control ...* |

**Kaynak belirtme dili:**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **According to** + kaynak | *According to police, ...* |
| **X said / told reporters / confirmed** | *a spokesperson told reporters* |
| **in a statement** | *In a statement, the company said ...* |
| **declined to comment** | *The minister declined to comment.* |
| **has not been confirmed** | *The cause **has not yet been confirmed**.* |
| **have not ruled out** | *Officials **have not ruled out** ...* |

**Nesnellik:**

- Kişisel görüş yok: ~~This terrible fire ...~~
- Doğrulanmamış bilgi için kişisiz edilgen: *is believed to / is thought to*
- Duygu sadece **alıntılarda**: *"We left with nothing," said ...*
- **Rakamlar ve kesin bilgiler**: *an estimated 500 hectares*

examples.en: According to police, the man was arrested at the scene.
examples.tr: Polise göre adam olay yerinde tutuklandı.

examples.en: Officials have not ruled out the possibility of sabotage.
examples.tr: Yetkililer sabotaj ihtimalini göz ardı etmedi.

examples.en: In a statement, the company apologised to its customers.
examples.tr: Şirket yaptığı açıklamada müşterilerinden özür diledi.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe haber metinleri bazen duygusal sıfatlar ("korkunç yangın", "acı olay") ve yazarın yorumlarıyla başlar. İngilizce haber yazımında (özellikle ajans haberlerinde) duygular alıntılara bırakılır ve gazeteci nesnel kalır. Ayrıca İngilizce haberlerde kaynak belirtmek çok önemlidir: Doğrulanmamış her bilgi "is believed to", "according to" ya da "has not been confirmed" ile işaretlenir.

options: This terrible fire has destroyed our beautiful forests.
The fire has destroyed an estimated 500 hectares of forest.
The fire started in a field.

task.modelAnswer:
FISHERMEN RESCUED AFTER TWO DAYS AT SEA

Three fishermen who had been missing off the Black Sea coast since Sunday were rescued yesterday morning, about 40 kilometres north of Sinop.

The men, aged between 28 and 56, are believed to have lost power after their boat's engine failed in rough weather on Sunday evening. They are reported to have survived on rainwater and a small supply of bread.

According to the coast guard, the men were spotted by a passing cargo ship, whose crew raised the alarm. A rescue helicopter reached the boat within an hour. All three are said to be in good condition, although one is thought to have suffered a minor hand injury.

It is understood that the boat's radio had stopped working shortly after the engine failure. There are thought to have been several other boats in the area at the time, but none of them had noticed the men's signals.

"We had almost given up hope," said Ali Kara, the youngest of the three. "When we saw the ship, we just cried."

In a statement, the coast guard reminded all fishermen to check the weather forecast carefully before going out to sea. An investigation into the engine failure is expected to be completed next week.

LOCAL BAKERY WINS NATIONAL BREAD AWARD

A small family bakery in Eskişehir has been named the best bakery in Turkey at this year's national bread competition, held in Ankara on Saturday.

The bakery, which is said to have been founded in 1962, beat more than 400 other businesses from across the country. Its sourdough loaf is believed to be made using a recipe that has not changed for three generations.

According to the competition organisers, the judges were particularly impressed by the bread's flavour and texture. It is understood that the bakery uses only local flour, and there are thought to be just four people working there, all of them members of the same family.

The owner, Fatma Özkan, 64, is reported to have started working in the bakery at the age of twelve. "I still can't believe it," she told reporters. "My father would have been so proud."

In a statement, the mayor of Eskişehir congratulated the family and said the award would "put the city on the map".

Since the news broke, queues are reported to have formed outside the bakery every morning. The family is expected to open a second shop later this year.
